title: Smart Data Models - Catena-X - PartType
description: A Part Type represents an item in the Catena-X Bill of Material (BOM) on a type level in a specific version. (Catena-X aspect model urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.part_type:2.0.0#PartType, translated from the SAMM-generated JSON Schema; aspect property names and nested structures are kept verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Built as urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<UUID of the Catena-X digital twin (globalAssetId without the urn:uuid: prefix)>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PartType'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

partTypeInformation.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.part_type:2.0.0#partTypeInformation'. The part type from which the serialized part has been instantiated.

partClassification.description: Property describing the classification of a part.

items.description: Encapsulates data related to the classification of the part.

id.description: The classification ID of the part type according to the corresponding standard definition mentioned in the key value pair.

description.description: Optional property describing the classification standard.

nameAtManufacturer.description: Name of the part as assigned by the manufacturer

manufacturerPartId.description: Part ID as assigned by the manufacturer of the part. The Part ID identifies the part (as designed) in the manufacturer`s dataspace. The Part ID does not reference a specific instance of a part and thus should not be confused with the serial number or batch number.

partSitesInformationAsPlanned.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.part_type:2.0.0#partSitesInformationAsPlanned'. A site is a delimited geographical area where a legal entity does business (geographical address with geo coordinates). A site always has a primary physical address. It is possible that further physical addresses are specified for the site. P.O. box details are only possible in addition to the physical address. A site has a 1:n relation to addresses, means at least one address is necessary and multiple addresses are possible.

items.description: Describes the ID, function and validity date of a site for the associated part in the AsPlanned context.

siteId.description: The identifier of the site according to BPDM. The siteId must be a valid BPN. The BPN is a unique, unchangeable identifier for business partners / company locations from foundation to closure, regardless of the different business relationships / structures between or within the business partners or company locations.

function.description: The function of the site in relation to the part (i.e. the activity within the value chain of the part that is performed at the site).

functionValidFrom.description: Timestamp, from when the site has the specified function for the given part.

functionValidUntil.description: Timestamp, until when the site has the specified function for the given part.

globalAssetId.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.common:1.0.0#globalAssetId'. The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.
